subject: Identifier
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1019a). "Object-view-1 is defined by 8.4.3.5, Object-view." (cite.py --check 8.4.3.1.3 -> OK 6)). Identifier Format 5 now exists (rows FMT-8.4.3.5.2, GR-8.4.3.5.4-1..7) and composes with the other formats per 8.4.3.1.4 GR1 c): the view applies to the identifier on its left before the inline invocation operator (`OU AS PB1425VD :: "GETNAME"` -> VD-OBJ), and its identifier-1 may be a function-identifier or a view (repeated phrase).
